verdict.rationale: The developer docs are served under an /openapi/ path (e.g., /openapi/webhooks_api.md), which suggests OpenAPI-derived per-API reference pages. A Postman guide also exists, implying the API can be imported into tooling, but no downloadable spec file is explicitly documented. The probe found 404s at all standard OpenAPI paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known). That only shows no spec at conventional locations, so it is not a concrete contradiction of a vendor claim. missing for 10: an explicitly documented download link for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec or Postman collection, confirmation that the spec covers all APIs, and hands-on corroboration that the file can be retrieved.
